description: This is a unit test class for the AcknowledgementRequests component in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.acks package. It tests various functionalities including immutability, null handling, parsing, and correctness of acknowledgment request creation.

classes.name: AcknowledgementRequestsTest
classes.description: The test class for AcknowledgementRequests, verifying immutability, null handling, and correct behavior of acknowledgment request creation and parsing.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the AcknowledgementRequests class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetNewAcknowledgementRequestForNullLabel
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as label to newAcknowledgementRequest throws NullPointerException with proper message.

methods.name: getNewAcknowledgementRequestReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that a valid acknowledgment label produces the correct acknowledgment request instance.

methods.name: tryToParseAcknowledgementRequestFromNull
methods.description: Ensures that parsing null request throws NullPointerException with proper message.

methods.name: tryToParseAcknowledgementRequestFromStringWithInvalidLabel
methods.description: Checks that invalid label string causes an AcknowledgementRequestParseException with proper message and cause.

methods.name: parseAcknowledgementRequestFromValidStringRepresentation
methods.description: Verifies that parsing a valid acknowledgment label string returns the expected acknowledgment request.
